name: Neural Shock
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level druid 2, magus 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration see text
Saving Throw Will partial (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You jolt the target’s mind with electricity. The target takes 1d6 points of electricity damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10). The target must then make a Will save or be staggered for 1 round per caster level. The target gains another Will save to end the effect at the beginning of each of their rounds.
